item.title: Week 10: Texans at Browns
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: HOU -4.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model CLE 47% vs. market 36% | On paper this matchup is close, with Houston's best reason its passing game, ranked 6th in EPA per dropback (+0.22) against a Cleveland defense ranked 13th (+0.01 allowed). Cleveland's counter is its defense's 1st-ranked stuff rate (18%) versus Houston's 25th (19%). Stroud ranks 6th of 31 in EPA per dropback to Watson's 24th of 31, and Houston's Dalton Schultz, averaging 3.9 yards of separation (6th of 76), is the x-factor against a Cleveland pass defense ranked 13th. The model favors Houston at a 53% win probability, mainly on the starting QB factor (+2.3 points) and the passing matchup (+2.1 points).
